description: Paid ($0.01 USDC on Base, x402). Full signed history and current values, verifiable offline. Agent memory: export the full signed history and current values of the paying wallet's persistent key-value store, for backup or proof. The export verifies offline against the public key in /menu, with no trust in the server. The optional since parameter returns only newer entries.. Settles before it runs (a free check refuses a call that would fail). Call once without payment to get the price, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: tabularium_export
